reason: Evidence shows this is a DSH plugin focused on coordinating multiple sessions by relaying messages, using role-based addressing, and supporting a coding/review loop with reliable delivery and persisted local state, so it is best classified as orchestration/automation for collaborative agent workflows.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 跨会话通信插件，提供按角色寻址的消息发送与持久化投递能力，支持编码与评审会话之间的协作流程衔接。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin for cross-session communication, providing role-based message routing with persistent delivery and support for coordinating coding-review collaboration workflows.

capabilities: Cross-session message delivery and follow-up triggering
Role-to-session registration and lookup for message routing
Persistent local storage for mailbox and role mappings
Local review issue state tracking via a ledger file
